comment: Wave-1 (F0) PINNED external-tool manifest. Local certifiers (lean, z3, ollama) are referenced by ABSOLUTE path (never PATH); the cross-family class is GEMINI-PRIMARY via the agy CLI (kind=cli-agy, no HTTP endpoint / no key — reached by driver_ref through the agy login) + ollama-FALLBACK. The F0 probe spawns each local tool from a clean shell (no shell interpolation), runs the cross-family PRIMARY (Gemini via agy) FIRST, and runs each tool's per-class integrity sentinels before any certifier is trusted. Local paths verified on this host 2026-06-22; cross-family moved to the agy transport 2026-07-06.

cross_family.note: Substrate (2026-07): cross-family certification is GEMINI-PRIMARY via the agy CLI (frontier LABEL "Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)") with ollama-FALLBACK. The F0 probe runs the PRIMARY first; a Gemini that is unreachable / times out / errors, OR that agy SUBSTITUTES or cannot ATTEST (served != the requested LABEL — the silent-Flash tripwire), is QUARANTINED and the probe falls back to ollama (stamping tier=fallback => PLAUSIBILITY-CORROBORATED). If the ollama fallback ALSO fails its sentinel, the cross-family lift HARD-FAULTS to CONJECTURAL (the system NEVER runs with an un-probed cross-family backend). The frontier CORROBORATED rung is enabled ONLY after a passing FRONTIER-CANARY SELF-TEST (a real agy round-trip whose INDEPENDENT re-run reproduces the normalized VERDICT — verdict-level, never an answer/transcript hash) from the ATTESTED frontier LABEL.

gemini.note: Cross-family PRIMARY (2026-07): the frontier Google family via the Antigravity CLI `agy` (genuinely generator-INDEPENDENT of Claude). NO HTTP endpoint and NO API key — agy is reached through the user LOGIN, addressed by a human LABEL ("Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)", NEVER an API-style id, which agy silently degrades to Flash), via the proven transport at driver_ref (<path> `agy -p` with served-model ATTESTATION (served==requested) and a no-shell steer. Deterministic-enough decoding at the verdict level (the frontier-canary self-test reproduces the normalized VERDICT, never a token/transcript hash). This replaces the DEAD Gemini HTTP API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com, at $0/429). The live seam is env-gated (CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE=1); the fast `node --test` gate injects a stub and spawns no agy. The model LABEL here MUST byte-match cross-family-verifier.mjs FRONTIER_MODEL or the frontier CORROBORATED rung silently degrades to fallback.

lean.note: Core Lean only; mathlib (multi-GB) FLAGGED follow-on. Verified 1+1=2 := rfl -> exit 0, 1+1=3 := rfl -> exit 1.

lake.note: Lean build driver; pinned for completeness. Core Lean only (no mathlib this increment).

z3.note: Used ONLY within z3-DECIDABLE theories (LIA/LRA/BV); quantified number-theory/analysis is out of scope this increment (fail-CLOSED on unknown). Verified sat/unsat.

ollama.note: Cross-family FALLBACK (non-Claude) verifier panel, used when the Gemini PRIMARY is quarantined (key-missing / 401|403 / 429 / unreachable). A weaker soft-check tier => PLAUSIBILITY-CORROBORATED (NOT a proof oracle). A SINGLE cold generation measured >200s on this host, so a persistent server + a paid-once warm-up is REQUIRED; per-call model reload is forbidden. The bare `ollama run` default is NOT temp 0 — deterministic decoding is pinned below.

cross_family_probe.note: P8 probabilistic-class integrity: N=5 trials at deterministic decoding on a known-true + known-false battery (5/5 each) PLUS a proof-JUDGING sentinel (a planted plausible-but-wrong proof the panel MUST reject). A model that accepts the wrong proof is QUARANTINED from the PLAUSIBILITY-CORROBORATED path.

faithfulness_instance_battery.comment: Wave-4 (F2+F3) reads this. The metamorphic concrete-instance battery is tool/cross-family/human/PRNG-sourced (NEVER Claude-enumerated), provenance-stamped, coupled to a non-vacuity check.
